title: Workload point on the measured Roofline
description: One achieved operating point, produced by hwbench.llm_adapter from llm-backend-analysis or any other workload. Operations are modeled unless stated; bytes_source says where traffic came from.

isa_path.description: execution path; selects the ceiling it is judged against

intensity.description: operations per byte of memory traffic

cores.description: compute cores used (55 for the LLM servers)

provenance.description: backend, version, model, ISL/OSL, concurrency (batch), placement, and how operations were obtained
